_comment: One current release per official input file. Only entries with status 'active' are published: tools/build_index.py writes them to docs/patches/index.json and copies ONLY their patch JSONs into docs/patches/. 'pending' entries are kept here until the owner releases them.

releases.title: IC-9700 E 1.50 + transverter support (20261113v3)
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (TRV1–TRV8, RF / IF on 2 m, 70 cm or 23 cm), RF shown up to 122 GHz
Separate active transverter for MAIN and SUB (SET > Transverter > MAIN Active / SUB Active); DUAL watch shows each receiver's own RF
MAIN/SUB exchange swaps the transverter selection together with the bands
SAT mode: transmit settings (power cap, TX delay, PTT inhibit) follow SUB Active; normal mode: MAIN Active
Per-transverter maximum TX power, TX delay (up to 300 ms, all modes) and PTT inhibit
CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms (6-byte BCD above 1.4 GHz, as IC-905)
Scope Set > Scope dB/div: 10 / 6 / 3 / 1 dB per division for spectrum and waterfall, noise floor anchored automatically (MAIN and SUB independently)
SD-card apps: MENU > SET > Apps (\IC-9700\Apps\)
Custom A/B bootloader: hold POWER while connecting DC (~5 s) to boot the other firmware slot
Opening screen shows 'customized by Dawid SQ6EMM - 20261113v3'; the radio's version text stays official 1.50

releases.title: IC-705 E 1.40 + transverter support (20261113v1)
features: Transverter support: 8 slots (TRV1–TRV8, RF / IF), RF shown on the display up to 122 GHz
CI-V frequency read/write in RF terms
Per-transverter maximum TX power and TX delay (up to 300 ms, all modes)
Scope Set > Scope dB/div: 10 / 6 / 3 / 1 dB per division for spectrum and waterfall, noise floor anchored automatically
Custom A/B bootloader: hold POWER at power-on until the LED blinks (~3 s) to boot the other firmware slot
Opening screen shows 'customized by Dawid SQ6EMM - 20261113v1'; the radio's version text stays official
SD-card apps: MENU > SET > Apps (\IC-705\Apps\)
Extended TX ranges and 4 m (70 MHz) TX from the E base build
